rule: Main figures: 7 per series. Supplements: not fixed, about 2 to 3 times the main count. A figure's status comes from its dependencies, not from intent. No figure shows a result before the checklist item that produces it has closed. Omission figures 02 to 07 are owner-TBD and show no omission outcome before blind omission (AGENTS.md firewall). Citations are UNSET until verified against the papers.
authority: owner, chat 2026-11-06 (main figure scope); supplements and statuses proposed by the builder
owner_questions: Sources located 2026-11-06 in the komposer repo, bibliography/ (files read by title only; authors and years UNSET until read): spectrolaminar motif 2022 and Mendoza-Halliday 2024 files, the Major 2026 reply, Campagnola 2022 (Science, local connectivity and synaptic dynamics, DOI 10.1126/science.abj5861). CAMINOS is the mechanism name of Tahvili, Vinck and di Volo (Cell Reports 2025; PLoS CB 2026), not a separate paper; JaxFNE already ports it. Still missing: Disney et al. (SST-CB and CR-VIP overlap); owner can supply the PDFs.
Figure 01 reward feedback: the paradigm spec lists reward schedule as an unresolved field; draw it marked unresolved or supply the timing.

Omission figures 02 to 07: adopt the proposed mirrors of Draft-S (from omission-mac, inferred) or set other topics. A model has no behaviour, so Draft-S fig03 and fig04 have no analogue unless a readout is added.

conventions.source: omission-mac 2026-11-06 (read-only; owner file context/figures/figstyle.py in the omission repo)
match: house style, area order and colors, class colors, band colors, stimulus and omission shading, slot colors
bold lowercase panel letters on main figures, drawn in the SVG (omission-mac correction: Hamm 2026-11-02, their todo row RN; their current renders still show uppercase until re-rendered)
folder per figure: png, svg, generated readme, generator code, data csv under 1 MiB, one receipt json
caption: one bold letter per panel, estimand, unit of inference, test and family
placeholder or synthetic content carries a red PLACEHOLDER-DUMMY title
conventions.constraint: Draft-S makes no cell-type claims. PV, SST and VIP appear on the model side only, never as a reading of recorded units.

figures.title: Spectrolaminar motif: concept, oscillations, LFP, ubiquity
figures.content: The motif (gamma superficial, alpha-beta deep, L4 crossover), how LFP and relative power by depth express oscillations, and how widely the motif occurs across areas and species. Sources: Mendoza-Halliday et al. and the Major et al. reply.

figures.title: Oscillation mechanisms I: network
figures.content: Synfire chain, PING, PINB, sparse random connectivity, E-I loops: schematic of each and the frequency it predicts. Proposed split with figure 03: network-level mechanisms here.
figures.data_needed: none (schematics); optional isolated-module traces from item 11

figures.title: Oscillation mechanisms II: cellular and laminar
figures.content: Subthreshold oscillations, membrane time constant, and the CAMINOS mechanism (Tahvili, Vinck and di Volo): how single-cell timescales set preferred frequency. Proposed split with figure 02.
sources: Tahvili, Vinck, di Volo, Cell Reports 2025 and PLoS CB 2026 (CAMINOS)
figures.data_needed: none (schematics); rheobase and time-constant table from item 6

figures.title: LANSA primate cell-type densities
figures.content: PV, CB, CR and NG density per depth bin and area (11 areas, 21 bins); NG is the pyramidal proxy, there is no separate E column.

figures.title: Observed microcircuit and type mapping
figures.content: Mapping PV/E/CB/CR to PV/E/SST/VIP, with the CB~SST and CR~VIP overlap reported by Disney and colleagues stated as an assumption with its uncertainty; the resulting SST/PV ratio by depth.

figures.title: Connectivity mapping and the SST/PV hypothesis
figures.content: Campagnola et al. 2022 mouse V1 connection probabilities mapped onto the column's type pairs; the CAMINOS wiring (strong SST to PV, PV to SST about zero, SST to SST about zero); the hypothesis that an SST/PV ratio peaking deep and dipping superficially causes the motif, and the prediction that reversing it reverses the motif (a test with a falsifier, item 17, not a result here).
figures.data_needed: published probability tables; wiring file from item 7
